capabilities.name: Restore session

source_evidence.detail: Session state is restored before protected routes render.

capabilities.expected_behavior: A valid saved session restores signed-in state and an invalid session returns to sign-in.

android.rationale: Android retains the same session outcomes with native storage and lifecycle handling.

requirements: Valid and invalid saved sessions produce their expected destinations

evidence.detail: Covers valid, expired, and corrupt saved sessions.

capabilities.name: Update profile

source_evidence.detail: Observed validation, saving, success, and server-error behavior.

capabilities.expected_behavior: A signed-in user can validate and persist profile changes.

android.rationale: The product outcome is preserved with Android navigation and form conventions.
android.adaptation: Use a Compose form with Android back handling and retained draft state.

requirements: Validation and server failures are distinguishable

evidence.detail: Exercised success and error paths on an Android device.

capabilities.name: Browser install prompt

source_evidence.detail: Offers browser-specific progressive web app installation.

capabilities.expected_behavior: Eligible browsers can request installation of the web application.

android.rationale: The Android application is distributed as an installed package.
android.justification: Browser-managed progressive web app installation has no in-app Android equivalent in this release scope.
